input.body: We are writing to request a review of the $18.75 deduction on DoorDash order DD-48230 from 2026-11-04, which was charged with the reason given as a missing item (Green Smoothie). Our records show the order was ready at 13:24 and was picked up by the courier at 13:29, five minutes later [DD-48230:pickup_handoff]. This means the order left our restaurant in the courier's hands after it was ready. Our order ticket lists the Green Smoothie as part of the order, though the ticket alone does not show how the order was packed. We are sharing only what our records show and have no further information about what happened after handoff. We kindly ask that you review this deduction and reverse it. Thank you for your time and consideration.
